Component state & reusable API
Field: pending words become acknowledged after the reply.
Archive: each receiver owns its alphabetical order.
This demo has its own state. Invalid input is rejected before transit. Replaying a request returns its existing receipt. The receiver’s index is recorded at the moment of acknowledgement.

Define props, geometry, contracts and behavior in one TypeScript component. Type-check it, try the compiled result, then export a portable JavaScript module. The compiler stays on the development server.

This copies compiled JavaScript into the workshop below. Run it there to save a reusable preset. Keep the TypeScript source for future edits.
Compilation manifest
TypeScript catches type errors. Runtime contracts still check incoming props and method data. Geometry uses the existing typed-buffer and WebGL2 renderer; this adds no compiler to deployed pages.
